question.title: Kahn's Topological Sorting with Cycle Detection
question.prompt: Implement Kahn's algorithm (BFS with in-degree array) in C++ to find a valid topological ordering of a directed graph with V vertices and E edges. If the graph contains a directed cycle, detect it and report that topological sort is impossible.
question.solutionNotes: 1. Compute in-degree of every vertex. 2. Enqueue all vertices with in-degree 0. 3. While queue not empty, pop u, add to result order, decrement in-degree of all neighbors. If neighbor in-degree becomes 0, enqueue it. 4. If result.size() != V, cycle exists.

sectionSpecificAllowances.sec_a: Dr. Kazi Tanvir Ahmed: Output must state 'Cycle detected' if result count < V.
sectionSpecificAllowances.sec_b: Prof. Tariq Mahmud: Both 0-indexed and 1-indexed vertex representations accepted.
sectionSpecificAllowances.sec_c: Lec. Nusrat Jahan: DFS-based topological sort with 3-color cycle detection also accepted.

rubricCriteria.title: In-Degree Computation & Zero-Degree Initialization
rubricCriteria.description: Correctly calculates incoming edges for all nodes and pushes 0 in-degree nodes into a queue.
rubricCriteria.fullCredit: Accurate in-degree count for all V vertices and pushes initial 0 in-degree nodes (1.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.partialCredit: In-degree computed with minor indexing error or misses some 0 in-degree nodes (0.5 - 1.0 mark).
rubricCriteria.zeroCredit: Wrong graph traversal setup or incorrect in-degree logic (0.0 marks).

rubricCriteria.title: BFS Edge Relaxation & Queue Traversal
rubricCriteria.description: Pops vertices, decrements neighbor degrees, and pushes when degree reaches 0.
rubricCriteria.fullCredit: Correctly decrements neighbor degrees and pushes to queue precisely when in-degree drops to 0 (2.0 marks).
rubricCriteria.partialCredit: Pushes neighbors without decrementing or pushes multiple times (1.0 mark).
rubricCriteria.zeroCredit: Flawed BFS traversal that does not reduce in-degrees (0.0 marks).

rubricCriteria.title: Cycle Detection Verification
rubricCriteria.description: Verifies whether processed vertex count equals V; identifies directed cycle.
rubricCriteria.fullCredit: Explicitly compares count/result.size() against V and returns or prints cycle detection (1.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.partialCredit: Outputs partial topological order but forgets cycle check (0.5 - 1.0 mark).

penalties.title: Missing Directed Cycle Guard
penalties.description: Returned partial ordering without validating whether visited count equals V.

penalties.title: Duplicate Queue Insertions
penalties.description: In-degree decremented past zero leading to redundant node reprocessing.
